usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Equatorial Guinea
usdRate.note: 2025 average. The franc CFA is fixed at 655.957 per euro, so the dollar rate moves with the euro.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bank of Central African States (BEAC), note on CEMAC inflation, Q2 2026 (national CPI, Equatorial Guinea)
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 3.2% year on year in June 2026 in Equatorial Guinea (BEAC table of national CPIs); the annual average was 2.3%. The national statistics office (INEGE) site was not reachable.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BEAC: CEMAC inflation convergence norm of 3%; franc CFA fixed to the euro
inflation_projection.note: The franc CFA is fixed to the euro and the BEAC holds CEMAC inflation under a 3% norm; Equatorial Guinea's annual average inflation was 3.4% in 2024 and 2.3% in 2025 (BEAC), so the 3% norm is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: BEAC Monetary Policy Committee, press release of 28 September 2026 (Taux d'intérêt des appels d'offres)
policy_rate.note: BEAC tender rate (TIAO) held at 4.50% on 28 September 2026 (marginal lending facility 5.75%, deposit facility 0%); the rate is common to all six CEMAC countries.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BEAC Monetary Policy Report, September 2026, Annex 1 (Taux Créditeur Minimum)
savings_account_rate.note: Minimum rate banks must pay on savings accounts of individuals (Taux Créditeur Minimum), 2.45% unchanged since 8 July 2014; banks usually pay this floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found; the BEAC publishes lending rates (TEG) by country but no deposit rates beyond the 2.45% savings floor.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found; the BEAC publishes lending rates (TEG) by country but no term deposit rates.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Equatorial Guinea
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.45% in 2017, the latest World Bank value (older than 2025); it equals the BEAC minimum savings rate (Taux Créditeur Minimum), still 2.45% in the BEAC September 2026 report.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Treasury borrows through BEAC-run auctions of bills and bonds.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BEAC, Statistiques mensuelles du marché des valeurs du Trésor de la CEMAC, January 2026 (coût des ressources, BTA, Guinée Equatoriale)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average cost of Treasury bills (BTA, 13 to 52 weeks) issued by Equatorial Guinea in January 2026; no separate 13-week yield is published.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BEAC, Statistiques mensuelles du marché des valeurs du Trésor de la CEMAC, January 2026 (coût des ressources, OTA, Guinée Equatoriale)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average cost of Treasury bonds (OTA, 2 years and more) issued by Equatorial Guinea in December 2025 (10.39% in January 2025); no OTA was issued in January 2026 and no yield for an exact 5-year maturity is published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Treasury bond yield for Equatorial Guinea was found; the BEAC yield curve chart in its January 2026 statistics covers only Cameroon, Congo and Gabon.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax on bank interest received by resident individuals could not be confirmed; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (reviewed 21 November 2025) gives 15% withholding on interest paid to non-residents only.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists, and the tax treatment of Treasury security income for individuals could not be confirmed.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Guarantee Fund of Central Africa (FOGADAC), FAQ
deposit_insurance_limit.note: FOGADAC covers deposits up to XAF 8 million per individual depositor (read 31 October 2026); covers banks in all CEMAC countries, including Equatorial Guinea.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found; the BEAC reports an average effective lending rate (TEG) of 13.82% in Equatorial Guinea in Q2 2026, but not for cards.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BEAC: franc CFA fixed to the euro; no Equatorial Guinea companies of note on the regional exchange (BVMAC)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for global equities held in euro (franc CFA) terms; there is no usable local stock index.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BEAC: franc CFA fixed to the euro; no Equatorial Guinea companies of note on the regional exchange (BVMAC)
equity_return_base.note: No local stock index record, so equity means a global index in euro terms, held about 4 points above an after-tax safe saving rate of about 2.5-3%.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BEAC: franc CFA fixed to the euro; no Equatorial Guinea companies of note on the regional exchange (BVMAC)
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities repeat their long-run euro-terms record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Franc CFA fixed at 655.957 per euro (BEAC); dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold prices with no currency loss under the euro peg.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Franc CFA fixed at 655.957 per euro (BEAC); dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run gold trend of about 4-5% a year in euro terms, which the franc CFA follows.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Franc CFA fixed at 655.957 per euro (BEAC); dollar gold trend

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury market statistics January 2026
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings accounts at the 2.45% minimum rate, less any tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury market statistics January 2026
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: savings and term deposits a little above the 2.45% floor; Treasury yields are higher but mostly bought by banks and institutions.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury market statistics January 2026
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: part of savings in government securities, whose issue cost was 8-10% in 2025-2026, after default and liquidity risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio was found from CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) or the national insurance directorate.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per XAF 1,000 of cover were found; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Equatorial Guinea
oop_health_share.note: 66.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BEAC note on CEMAC inflation Q2 2026: health prices +1.5% year on year in June 2026 (CEMAC)
goal_inflation_health.note: CEMAC health prices rose 1.5% in June 2026, but private and imported care costs run faster, so health goals use 1.5 points above the 3% planning inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BEAC note on CEMAC inflation Q2 2026: education prices +0.8% year on year in June 2026 (CEMAC)
goal_inflation_education.note: CEMAC education prices rose 0.8% in June 2026, but private school fees rise faster, so education goals use 1 point above the 3% planning inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Equatorial Guinea

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (the page gives a both-sexes figure only at 65).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.36 (2025, World Bank), 8.2 (2040, populationpyramid.net/equatorial-guinea/2040/) and 10.9 (2065, populationpyramid.net/equatorial-guinea/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The old-age pension age could not be confirmed: the INSESO old-age pension page (inseso.org/prestacion/pension-por-vejez) lists only documents required, and the ISSA and US SSA country profiles were not reachable.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury bill issue cost 8.18% (January 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts at the 2.45% minimum rate, less any tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury bill issue cost 8.18% (January 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: bank deposits close to the 2.45% floor; kept well below the Treasury bill rate, since term deposit rates are not published and individuals rarely hold Treasury securities.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BEAC Taux Créditeur Minimum 2.45%; BEAC Treasury bill issue cost 8.18% (January 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a larger share in government securities.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 3%; global equity base 6.5% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 3%; global equity base 6.5% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, government securities, gold and foreign equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 3%; global equity base 6.5% in euro terms; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with more equity.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; the INSESO social benefits page lists only contributory pensions (old age, invalidity, survivors).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; the INSESO social benefits page lists only contributory pensions (old age, invalidity, survivors).

gratuity_rule.note: The end-of-service or dismissal indemnity provisions of the General Labour Law could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: INSESO runs the compulsory contributory old-age pension (contributions 21.5% employer and 4.5% employee per PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, reviewed 21 November 2025), but the pension age, qualifying period and indexation could not be confirmed from a readable source.

savings_account.note: Banks must pay at least the BEAC minimum savings rate (2.45%).

fdr_3m.note: Banks take term deposits (the BEAC sets reserve requirements on them), but rates are not published.

fdr_1y.note: Banks take term deposits, but rates are not published.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills are auctioned through the BEAC to banks and primary dealers (SVT); individuals cannot bid directly.

tbond_5y.note: Treasury bonds are auctioned through the BEAC to primary dealers; Equatorial Guinea issued none in January 2026.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year Treasury bond yield or issue was found.

equity_fund.note: No locally sold diversified equity fund was found; the regional exchange (BVMAC) lists very few companies.

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.

centralBank.name: Bank of Central African States (Banco de los Estados de África Central, BEAC)

insuranceRegulator.name: Inter-African Conference on Insurance Markets (CIMA), regional insurance regulator, with the national insurance directorate

insuranceComplaints.name: CIMA policyholder requests and complaints form

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Institute (Instituto Nacional de Seguridad Social, INSESO)

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Guarantee Fund of Central Africa (FOGADAC)

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics of Equatorial Guinea (INEGE)
statistics.note: Site blocks automated access; not read during research.
